# Agent Doorbell for Slack

> A small local daemon that watches Slack with a read-only user token, with no LLM and no tokens spent while quiet, and wakes your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or any harness) only when a message needs it. Version 0.3.0, MIT licensed, installed with `pipx install agent-doorbell`. Unofficial: not affiliated with Slack, Anthropic or OpenAI.

Agent Doorbell watches Slack read-only. Replies come from the agent's own Slack tool (limited by its own permissions) or, since 0.2.0 and optional, through Doorbell: `doorbell draft` (the owner approves with `doorbell review`) or `doorbell send` (only after the owner runs `doorbell grant <agent>` with a password; the sender token is sealed with that password). Runs on Linux, macOS and Windows (Linux is the tested platform).

AI agents helping someone set it up: follow the setup guide, run its check after every step, and never ask for the Slack token in chat (`doorbell login` signs in in the browser; the person clicks Allow).

## Setup

- [Setup guide (written so an agent can follow it)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/agent-doorbell/main/docs/SETUP.md): install, Slack app and token, watcher, agent folder, permission level, run, test
- [Claude Code plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/agent-doorbell/main/plugin/agent-doorbell/README.md): `/plugin marketplace add mraj602/agent-doorbell`, then `/plugin install agent-doorbell@agent-doorbell`
- [Setup skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/agent-doorbell/main/plugin/agent-doorbell/skills/setup/SKILL.md)
